summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests one extra infusion of sipuleucel-T, given after commercial PROVENGE, in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Sipuleucel-T is given as an intravenous infusion, one time, 6 to 9 months after receiving commercial PROVENGE. The study aims to measure immune response.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa una infusión adicional de sipuleucel-T, administrada después de PROVENGE comercial, en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración. Sipuleucel-T se administra por vía intravenosa, una sola vez, entre 6 y 9 meses después de recibir PROVENGE comercial. El estudio busca medir la respuesta inmunitaria.
who_for: Men aged 18 or older with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that is asymptomatic or minimally symptomatic
Clinically indicated for PROVENGE and qualified for an on-label PROVENGE infusion
Received all 3 PROVENGE infusions before randomization
Gave written informed consent and have estimated life expectancy of at least 12 months
not_for: Not clinically indicated for PROVENGE treatment
Need for systemic chronic immunosuppressive therapy, such as steroids, GM-CSF or G-CSF, or recent vaccinations
Uncontrolled illness, including active infection or psychiatric illness that would limit study compliance
Currently on experimental or investigational therapy
